questions.q: Aunt Tingan-ting hires Ar. Bogart to design a luxury spa in a resort complex. The project involves extensive details, including designs for built-in components like custom countertops, built-in equipment for the spa, special fittings for the relaxation rooms, architectural interior design for the entire space, and the development of the surrounding landscaping and site planning. The Project Construction Cost (PCC) is estimated at 40,000,000.00 PHP. What is the total professional fee that Ar. Bogart will receive for this project, based on the RPF?
questions.n: For specialized architectural services like Interior Design and Landscape Architecture, the fee typically ranges from 12% to 15% of the cost of the work; 15% of 40M is 6M.

questions.q: Aunt Tingan-ting owns a residential condominium building in the heart of Naga City. She hired Ar. Bogart to renovate and expand the building, which includes architectural and engineering retrofitting the structure for better seismic resistance, adding new floors, and upgrading the electrical and plumbing systems. The Project Construction Cost (PCC) is estimated at 30,000,000.00 PHP. What would be the total professional fee for Ar. Bogart for the renovation project?
questions.n: For renovations and additions, the professional fee is typically 150% of the regular fee; 150% of 6% is 9%. 9% of 30M is 2.7M.

questions.q: Aunt Tingan-ting hires Ar. Bogart for a consultation regarding the best structural solutions for her upcoming apartment project. She needs Ar. Bogart's professional opinion on the technical feasibility of incorporating specific design elements into the project. The consultation is expected to take 3 hours. How much is the minimum professional fee for Ar. Bogart?
questions.n: The standard minimum fee for professional consultation is 1,000 PHP per hour (as of the SPP guidelines).

questions.q: Aunt Tingan-ting hires Ar. Bogart, an architect residing in Metro Manila, for a consultation regarding the best structural solutions for her upcoming apartment project. She needs Ar. Bogart's professional opinion on the technical feasibility of incorporating specific design elements into the project. The consultation is expected to take 5 hours in Davao City. How much is the minimum professional fee for Ar. Bogart?
questions.n: This includes the 5,000 PHP for the 5-hour consultation plus the standard 3,000 PHP per diem for work required outside of the office's radius.

questions.q: Aunt Tingan-ting is involved in a legal dispute over the construction of her hotel. She hires Ar. Bogart to serve as an expert witness to provide testimony regarding the construction integrity of the building. The hearing is scheduled for next month, and the fee for each appearance as an expert witness is 5,000 PHP. Will Ar. Bogart be compensated for his appearance as an expert witness, regardless of whether the hearing takes place or not?
questions.n: The architect is paid for their availability and the reservation of their time, regardless of whether the court proceeds with the session.

questions.q: Aunt Tingan-ting hires Ar. Bogart to complete a set of plans for a 5-storey residential condominium building in Naga City. She wants Ar. Bogart to do DAEDS for the project and also take on full-time construction supervision services. The total Project Construction Cost (PCC) for the building is estimated at 40,000,000.00 PHP. How much is the minimum professional fee Ar. Bogart should receive for his services?
questions.n: DAEDS for Group 2 is 6% (2.4M). Full-time supervision (FTSC) is 1% to 1.5%. Using the 1% minimum (400k), the total is 2.8M.

questions.q: Aunt Tingan-ting hires Ar. Bogart to complete a set of plans for a 5-storey residential condominium building in Naga City. She wants Ar. The total Project Construction Cost (PCC) for the building is estimated at 40,000,000.00 PHP. The Consultant's fee for the interior design work is 800,000.00 PHP. How much is the minimum professional fee Ar. Bogart should receive for his service?
questions.n: The original fee was 2.8M. When a separate consultant is hired, the lead architect is entitled to a 5% coordination fee based on the consultant's fee (5% of 800k = 40k). 2.8M + 40k = 2.84M.

Is incentive-based compensation allowed for construction management services to motivate timely and efficient project completion?
questions.n: Standards of Professional Practice allow for incentive-based systems to encourage efficiency and cost-savings in management roles.

She also seeks a contract that stipulates a guaranteed maximum project cost, ensuring that she will not be affected by potential price increases throughout the duration of the project. To meet these needs, she hired Ar. Bogart for a design-build service for a 2-storey 3 bedroom residence. What is the name of this type of contract?
o: Design-Build Services on a Guaranteed Maximum Cost
questions.n: This specific contract shifts the risk of cost increases to the architect/builder, guaranteeing a ceiling price for the owner.

questions.n: Under SPP 207, the architect must not advance any money; however, the owner is responsible for all costs, and there is no provision for the architect to receive a construction 'downpayment' as profit before work.
